infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IBNK Banking needs camera access to capture KYC documents, applicant selfies, shop photographs, and 30-second Video KYC recordings.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IBNK Banking needs microphone access for recording audio and dynamic OTP recitation during 30-second Video KYC onboarding.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IBNK Banking needs photo library access to upload identity proofs, PAN cards, MSME certificates, and cancelled cheques.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID for rapid and secure authentication to your authorized IBNK banking portal.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow IBNK Banking to access camera for document scanning, merchant selfie capture, and Video KYC.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow IBNK Banking to authenticate using biometric sensors.
